deep.title: Occamy-1.0: Open Pareto-frontier 35B Intelligence for Co-work
deep.summary: Co-work agents execute complex workflows that combine information gathering, tool use, coding, and file manipulation across many model invocations. Because cost and latency accumulate over the full episode, their practical value depends not only on peak capability but also on how efficiently that capability is delivered. Yet many steps in everyday work emphasize state tracking, coordination, recovery, and follow-through rather than frontier-scale reasoning. We present Occamy-1.0, a cost-efficient co-work model obtained by further training the post-trained Qwen3.6-35B-A3B checkpoint. We construct execution-grounded data and environments, capture replayable long-horizon trajectories across multiple harnesses, and use staged post-training to develop and consolidate complementary execution capabilities. Across a broad suite of co-work benchmarks, Occamy-1.0 is consistently among the strongest comparably sized models and remains competitive with substantially larger frontier systems on several tasks. Under our stated evaluation and pricing protocol, its aggregate performance across four representative benchmarks places it at the low-cost knee of the observed cost--performance Pareto frontier. Supporting evaluations in tool calling, coding, and instruction following further show that this specialization preserves broad agentic capability. We release the model weights and a subset of the training data to support research on practical co-work agents and agentic post-training.

deep.analysis:
这是一篇关于 Occamy-1.0 模型的研究发布，该模型是一个专为“协同工作智能体”设计的 35B 参数开源模型，基于 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 后训练得到，旨在以更低的成本实现接近前沿模型的复杂任务执行能力。

此前的痛点在于，协同工作智能体在执行复杂工作流时，需要多次调用模型来完成信息收集、工具使用、代码编写和文件操作等步骤。成本和延迟会在整个执行周期中不断累积，因此智能体的实际价值不仅取决于单次推理的峰值能力，更取决于整个任务执行过程中的效率。然而，日常工作中的许多步骤，如状态跟踪、协调、错误恢复和任务跟进，并不需要前沿级别的深度推理能力，但现有模型往往以高昂的成本提供这些基础能力，造成了资源浪费。

技术流程和方法要点是这篇论文的核心。研究团队首先构建了“基于执行的数据和环境”，这意味着训练数据不是静态的文本对，而是包含实际执行反馈的交互轨迹。他们捕获了“可重放的长周期轨迹”，这些轨迹跨越多个测试框架，记录了智能体在真实工作流中的完整行为序列，包括成功和失败的路径。在此基础上，采用“分阶段后训练”策略来开发和巩固互补的执行能力，这种分阶段方法可能意味着先训练基础的工具调用和状态管理，再逐步叠加更复杂的协调和恢复能力。模型的基座是 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，这是一个已经过初步后训练的检查点，Occamy 在其基础上进一步训练，而非从零开始。评估结果显示，在多个协同工作基准测试中，Occamy-1.0 在同规模模型中持续表现最强，并在部分任务上与更大规模的前沿系统保持竞争力。特别值得注意的是，在四个代表性基准测试的聚合性能评估中，按照特定的评估和定价协议，该模型处于成本-性能帕累托前沿的“低成本拐点”位置，这意味着在给定的成本约束下，它能提供最优的性能表现。此外，在工具调用、代码编写和指令遵循等辅助评估中，模型保持了广泛的智能体能力，证明其专业化训练并未牺牲通用性。

对 AI 应用岗而言，这条资讯的生产可用性价值非常明确。面试中可以重点讨论“帕累托前沿拐点”这个概念，它直接回应了实际业务中成本与效果的平衡问题——不是追求绝对最强，而是在预算内做到最好。分阶段后训练的思路也值得关注，它提供了一种将通用模型转化为特定场景高效执行者的工程范式，可以类比为“先通才后专才”的训练策略。基于执行的数据构建方法强调了训练数据与实际运行环境的一致性，这是提升智能体在长周期任务中稳定性的关键，面试时可以结合自身项目经验，讨论如何设计类似的执行反馈循环来持续优化模型表现。最后，模型在保持专项能力的同时不丢失通用工具调用和编码能力，这一点对于构建生产级 AI 应用至关重要，因为真实场景中的工作流往往是开放和变化的，单一维度的优化可能导致系统脆弱。

deep.title: How we built LangChain’s GTM Agent
deep.summary: Learn how we built a GTM agent that increased lead conversion by 250% while saving each sales rep 40 hours per month
deep.score_reason: GTM agent提升转化250%并节省大量人工，有具体效果数据和工程细节，对agent落地生产极具参考价值
deep.analysis:
这是一篇来自 LangChain 官方博客的工程实践复盘，详细拆解了他们如何为自身市场推广（GTM，Go-To-Market）团队构建一个 AI Agent，最终实现了线索转化率提升 250%、每位销售代表每月节省 40 小时的效果。

此前，LangChain 的销售团队面临一个典型的规模化困境：大量入站线索需要人工筛选、研究和个性化外联，这个过程高度重复且耗时。销售代表每天要花数小时查阅潜在客户的公开信息、判断其与 LangChain 产品的契合度、再手动撰写定制化邮件。这种模式下，要么牺牲外联质量以追求数量，要么在高质量线索上投入过多人力而无法覆盖长尾。团队需要一个能在不增加人力成本的前提下，同时提升外联覆盖量和个性化程度的系统。

该 Agent 的技术架构围绕“研究-评分-生成”三阶段流水线设计。第一阶段是深度研究，Agent 接收一个公司名或域名后，会并行抓取多种公开数据源，包括公司官网、Crunchbase 融资信息、LinkedIn 员工资料、最新新闻和技术博客。这里的关键设计是使用结构化输出，让 LLM 从非结构化网页中提取出公司规模、所在行业、技术栈、近期融资事件等字段，存入一个标准化的公司档案中。第二阶段是线索评分，系统将档案与 LangChain 预设的理想客户画像进行比对，画像包含技术栈偏好（如是否使用 Python/Node）、团队规模、行业属性等维度，LLM 为每个维度打分并给出综合评级和理由。第三阶段是邮件生成，Agent 基于研究档案和评分理由，为每条线索生成高度个性化的外联邮件，邮件中会引用对方公司最近的技术动态、融资新闻或技术栈特点，并明确说明为何 LangChain 与其需求匹配。整个流程由 LangGraph 编排，支持长运行任务的状态持久化与人工审核节点——在邮件实际发送前，销售代表可以在一个内部看板中查看 Agent 生成的研究摘要、评分依据和邮件草稿，一键批准或修改后发出。

对 AI 应用岗面试而言，这个案例有多个可直接引用的工程要点。第一是“人在回路中”的设计，不是追求全自动，而是在关键决策点（邮件发送）保留人工确认，这降低了幻觉风险，也让销售团队愿意信任系统，是生产级 AI 应用落地的核心策略。第二是结构化输出在数据提取环节的应用，将非结构化网页转为可评分的结构化档案，这是 RAG 类应用常见但容易被忽视的工程细节。第三是评估体系的建立，LangChain 团队提到他们用 LLM-as-judge 方式对生成的邮件质量进行自动打分，同时追踪回复率等业务指标，形成离线评估与在线指标的双层验证。面试中如果被问到“如何评估一个 Agent 的好坏”，可以直接引用这种双层评估框架。第四是编排引擎的选择，LangGraph 提供的状态管理和人工中断能力，使得长流程 Agent 的调试和迭代变得可控，这比简单的链式调用更适合复杂业务场景。最后，这个案例也展示了 AI 应用的价值度量方式——不是模糊的“提效”，而是直接挂钩业务指标（转化率、人效节省），这是面试官最看重的产品思维。

deep.title: StepAudio 3 Gen Technical Report
deep.summary: We introduce StepAudio 3 Gen, a general-purpose audio generation model that supports zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS), voice design, vocal generation, sound effects, music, vibe speech, and mixtures of multiple audio types within a unified framework. At its core, StepAudio 3 Gen is a discrete autoregressive generator that models audio directly over residual vector quantization (RVQ) tokens, departing from the diffusion Transformer-based continuous generation paradigm prevalent in recent general audio models. Its StepAudio Tokenizer represents general audio at 12.5 Hz in a shared 16 times 2048 residual code space, jointly quantizing semantic and waveform-level acoustic features so that each code layer preserves both types of information. For generation, the backbone predicts the first codebook along the time axis using autoregressive modeling, while a lightweight causal Transformer completes the remaining fifteen codebooks along the codebook axis. Our study further identifies three key design principles: (1) interference-aware progressive pretraining for acquiring audio capabilities while preserving the textual abilities of the large language model, (2) RVQ Adaptor for effectively incorporating multi-codebook acoustic representations, and (3) discrete autoregressive modeling over a shared representation across general audio domains. deep.analysis:
StepAudio 3 Gen 是阶跃星辰发布的一个通用音频生成模型，它在一个统一框架内支持零样本文本转语音、声音设计、歌声生成、音效、音乐、情绪语音以及多种音频类型的混合生成。与近期主流通用音频模型采用的扩散 Transformer 连续生成范式不同，它回归到离散自回归路线，直接在残差向量量化（RVQ，一种将连续信号压缩为多层离散编码的技术）的 token 上对音频进行建模。

此前通用音频生成的痛点在于，不同音频类型（语音、音乐、音效）往往需要独立模型处理，且主流扩散模型虽然生成质量高，但推理速度慢、难以与语言模型自然融合。更重要的是，现有方案在扩展音频能力时容易“灾难性遗忘”语言模型原本的文本理解能力，导致指令跟随和语义对齐变差。StepAudio 3 Gen 试图用一个离散自回归框架统一解决这些矛盾，让单一模型既能理解复杂文本指令，又能生成多种音频。

技术实现上，模型的核心分为三块。首先是 StepAudio Tokenizer，它把任意音频压缩到 12.5Hz 的极低帧率，使用 16 层、每层 2048 码本的共享残差码空间。关键设计在于它联合量化了语义特征和波形层面的声学特征，使得每一层码本都同时保留两类信息，而不是像传统方案那样底层存声学、顶层存语义。生成阶段采用“时间轴自回归 + 码本轴并行”的混合策略：主干网络沿时间轴自回归预测第一层码本，再用一个轻量级因果 Transformer 沿码本轴一次性补全剩余 15 层。这种设计在保持生成质量的同时大幅降低了推理延迟。训练上，报告明确了三条设计原则：一是“干扰感知的渐进式预训练”，在注入音频能力时通过策略性数据混合与训练调度，保护大语言模型原有的文本能力不被覆盖；二是 RVQ Adaptor，一个专门适配多层离散声学表征的模块，让语言模型能高效吸收多码本信息；三是在通用音频域上坚持共享表征的离散自回归建模，避免为不同音频类型设计独立分支。

对 AI 应用岗而言，这份工作的启示在于它直面了“多模态扩展中的能力保留”和“生产级推理效率”两个工程核心问题。面试中可谈的点包括：12.5Hz 极低帧率对长音频生成成本和实时性的价值；联合量化语义与声学特征如何避免传统分层量化带来的信息割裂；时间轴与码本轴解耦的生成策略如何平衡自回归的序列依赖与推理速度；以及渐进式预训练中防止语言能力退化的具体数据策略，这直接关系到产品从“能生成”到“能听懂复杂指令”的跨越。这些设计思路对构建可落地的多模态应用有直接参考意义。

mid.title: LLaDA-UI: Bringing Block-wise Diffusion to Vision-Language GUI Agents
mid.summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) achieve high decoding efficiency through block-parallel, arbitrary-order generation, making them attractive for latency-sensitive applications. GUI agents represent a natural testbed for this paradigm, as they must repeatedly perceive screen states and emit structured, spatially grounded actions in real time. However, whether dLLMs can be extended into capable multimodal GUI agents while preserving their parallel decoding advantage remains an open question. We present LLaDA-UI, a 16.7B-parameter MoE-based, block-wise diffusion vision-language GUI agent. LLaDA-UI follows a two-stage training pipeline: general multimodal pre-training aligns a native-resolution vision encoder with the LLaDA2.0-mini-base diffusion language backbone, followed by GUI-agent supervised fine-tuning on diverse mobile, desktop, web, and grounding data. Across widely adopted grounding benchmarks and navigation benchmarks spanning multiple platforms, LLaDA-UI substantially outperforms Qwen2.5-VL-7B and surpasses Qwen3-VL-8B on four of six reported GUI benchmarks. These results establish block-wise diffusion as a practical generative paradigm for multimodal GUI agents.
mid.score_reason: LLaDA-UI 将块级扩散模型用于 GUI agent，直接面向 latency-sensitive 应用场景，方法新颖且可复现。
mid.analysis: LLaDA-UI 是一个基于块并行扩散机制的 16.7B 参数多模态 GUI 智能体，它将扩散大语言模型的高效并行解码能力引入视觉-语言任务。其核心方法采用两阶段训练：先用通用多模态预训练对齐原生分辨率视觉编码器与扩散语言骨干，再进行跨移动、桌面、网页等多种平台的 GUI 监督微调。该工作在多个主流定位与导航基准上显著超越 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，并在六项 GUI 基准中的四项优于 Qwen3-VL-8B，证明了块级扩散可作为多模态 GUI 智能体的实用生成范式。

engineering.title: TRACE: Trajectory-robust Admission with Evidence Ordering for Efficient GUI Agents
engineering.summary: GUI agents accumulate high-resolution screenshots as the trajectory unfolds, increasing inference latency and memory usage. Training-free visual token pruning can reduce this cost, but cache reuse introduces a fundamental constraint. Once tokens are discarded, the corresponding visual evidence cannot be recovered without re-encoding. Pruning therefore becomes an irreversible admission decision that must remain useful for unknown future targets while preserving coverage of operable regions under tight budgets. To address these challenges, we propose \method{}, a training-free framework for \textbf{Trajectory-robust Admission and Coverage-aware Evidence ordering}. Specifically, we combine a query-independent layout-derived interaction prior with instruction relevance and feature novelty to rank visual evidence according to both potential future utility and diversity. Then, we reserve part of the budget for native visual tokens distributed across the screen, repairing missing spatial coverage without breaking the ordering. Together, these mechanisms produce a nested token order, allowing retained visual evidence to shrink monotonically across budgets while remaining reusable throughout the trajectory. Finally, our monotone KV contraction incrementally contracts retired frames into compact session state, avoiding repeated visual encoding or pruning. engineering.title: DataFlex-RL: An Evaluation Platform for RLVR Data Policies
engineering.summary: Data policies for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) determine which rollouts are used, how strongly they are weighted, and which domains contribute to subsequent training batches. We introduce DataFlex-RL, an evaluation platform for comparing these choices under a common GRPO recipe. Our primary experiment evaluates 13 configurations across 12 matched seeds using Qwen2.5-7B-Base and 12 mathematics, logic, and science benchmarks. Uniform GRPO improves the domain-balanced average accuracy by 7.76 percentage points over the untrained checkpoint. None of the eight rollout-selection or reweighting methods achieves a paired 95% confidence interval that excludes zero relative to uniform sampling, and none of the three adaptive mixtures outperforms a fixed equal mixture at the same level of precision. A corrected 12-seed extension on Llama-3.1-8B-Base places the additional methods on the same score scale as the original controls, but does not reveal a consistent winner in terms of observed mean performance. We also quantify evaluation sensitivity by rescoring nine Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct runs using a math-heavy six-benchmark summary, consisting of five mathematics benchmarks and GPQA-Diamond but no logic benchmark, and comparing it with the domain-balanced 12-benchmark summary. engineering.title: Towards a Deterministic Math Solver for Clinical Language Models
engineering.summary: Large language models are unreliable at arithmetic, which is a problem for clinical calculators where a single numerical error changes the recommendation. The standard response is to hardcode each calculator as a validated function, one at a time. We test an alternative: the model does not calculate. Instead, it writes case-specific Python that a restricted local executor runs as a deterministic solver, and the model's task reduces to deciding how to use it. We evaluate this Program-Solve interface on MedCalc-Bench Verified (1,100 cases, 55 calculators) against direct model arithmetic and a hand-written 22-calculator library, using Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-32B-AWQ, after auditing the benchmark's formulas against current clinical guidelines and flagging 16 of 55 with version, use or coefficient concerns. With formulas and gold variables supplied and both routes reading the whole note, handing off to the solver is not a reliable advantage at 7B (75.31% against 72.02%, a paired +3.29 points with a 95% calculator-cluster interval of [-3.49, 10.38]) but is one at 32B (90.53% against 83.47%, +7.05 [0.47, 14.60], clear of zero). The hand-written library is exact on its 440 supported cases but abstains elsewhere (40.0% overall). Adding an executor thus helps some open-weight models more than others even under matched formula, variable and note access, and is not a substitute for verified formulas or reliable variable extraction either way.

engineering.title: Beyond Top-k Skill Retrieval: Diversity-Aware Skill Routing for LLM Agents
engineering.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external skills, but routing user requests over large skill registries is difficult because many skills are functionally redundant while complex tasks often require complementary skill sets. Existing skill routers typically rank candidates independently by query relevance, which can waste context budget on redundant skills. We propose Diverse Skill Routing (DSR), a diversity-aware reranking framework that uses a Determinantal Point Process to balance relevance and non-redundancy. DSR introduces a query-residual diversity kernel that penalizes redundant skill overlap while reducing penalties caused only by shared query relevance. On the SkillRouter benchmark, DSR improves recall and full coverage over a strong pointwise reranking baseline, with larger gains on multi-skill queries. These results suggest that skill routing should be treated not only as relevance ranking, but also as complementary set selection.

paper.title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
paper.summary: Recursive self-improvement is becoming increasingly vital for autonomous AI agents, where progress hinges on discovering high-value solutions across complex domains. paper.title: Attention-DP3: Spatially Object-aware 3D Diffusion Policy via Geometry-aligned Attentional Conditioning

paper.title: How Far Can Synthetic Data Take Thai OCR?

To study this setting, we introduce TRACE, a transformation-aware benchmark for post-fire object understanding. TRACE contains 21.4K real-image-grounded synthetic scenes and paired object-level pristine-to-degraded progressions spanning 499 object identities across 189 categories. We define five tasks targeting localization and pre-degradation understanding: degraded-object detection, pristine-state recovery and retrieval, original material recovery, pristine description generation, and functional reasoning. Existing models degrade sharply with severity. From the least to the most severe level, RF-DETR mAP decreases by 71% relative, while InternVL3.5 retrieval R@1 falls from 93.85 to 28.11. To address this, we propose the Feature Recovery Module (FRM), a plug-and-play module that maps degraded encoder features to pristine-aligned representations while keeping the host frozen. Trained only with paired feature supervision, FRM improves scene-level detection, CLIP/SigLIP2 feature recovery, and all four object-level VLM tasks, with larger gains under more severe degradation.
